name: Aomi Labs Task API — Arc Mainnet
description: Aomi Labs builds the execution harness for onchain finance. Its Task API lets agents inspect a simulated Arc Mainnet action before buying the exact unsigned transaction bundle: 0.01 USDC for preparation over x402, free status and signed preview, then a separate retrieval purchase at 3% of simulated gross outgoing USDC (free for zero outflow). The buyer's wallet signs and broadcasts.
